notes.title: Launch Eve!
notes.content:
It has been an exciting run in Early Access and I greatly appreciate everyone's feedback!  A huge thank-you for the patience while conquering the various issues and bugs!

Please tell your friends and enemies about the 33% launch discount!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/aed437e81f2b6fa2e1631afa56ea1fd28a241328.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Overlay is working - and much more!
notes.content:
There have been loads of updates and bug fixes in the past week or two!

First thing to note is that the Steam Overlay is working :D 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/700e0141c4ab2a49ad9ad6fe93ce9b7ecf363a99.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/125391a0c8a8e522f11c26457e0ddede8e53bd04.jpg[/img][/url]

Beyond that, there have been dozens of fixes to Interstellar Invaders! 

[list]
    [*]Two-player CoOp mode is available from the start of the game
    [*]You can now access CoOp mode from the menu screen mid game
    [*]The first boss has been updated to have additional obsticles in CoOp mode
    [*]Colors work properly while in Inverted mode
    [*]Other bug fixes that I can't remember!
[/list]

notes.title: New features update!
notes.content:
Hello folks! 

Loads of new things have been added to Interstellar Invaders!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/de44f7b1222413a1c37d1ff86e9bbdd3828d8613.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/fcce6fe7a626a27888796fff9a8bce30160acdff.png[/img][/url]

'Continues' have been added to the game - as something that can be earned if you get far enough.  This is a big improvement on the balance of the game!

Co-op mode has been greatly refined and dozens of songs have been added to the game, to add divirsity to the soundscape.

On the near horizon: Steam Achievents!
